description:
Generate (enqueue) a preflight proof for a file in a file session: the proof service checks the file against the product's print specs and produces a proof with any errors/warnings.

Returns { proofId, sessionId } once enqueued. Proof generation takes tens of seconds — after calling this, poll get_file_session_proofs until the proof whose `id` equals proofId reaches status COMPLETED, then report its errors/warnings.

**Artwork orientation (checked before every proof).** If the artwork is turned against the configured size (e.g. 6 x 4 landscape art on a 4 x 6 portrait postcard) and swapping width and height fits it, this tool CHANGES THE CONFIGURED SIZE to match the artwork before proofing. The result then carries `orientation`:
- `changedNow` (on the swap actions) is true only when THIS call changed the size. Announce a size change to the customer ONLY when `changedNow` is true, never otherwise.
- `action: "swapped"` (`changedNow: true`): the size was changed (`from` → `to`, plus the new `price`) and the proof uses the new size. You MUST tell the customer the size changed, and the price if it changed, in your next message.
- `action: "swapped-not-synced"` (`changedNow: true`): this call changed the size (`from` → `to`) but NO proof was started yet (no proofId) because the file service hasn't picked it up. Tell the customer the size changed, then call create_proof again in a few seconds.
- `action: "swapped-earlier"` (`changedNow: false`): the configuration already had the size that fits the artwork (an earlier create_proof changed it, or the customer chose it); nothing was changed now and this proof uses it. Don't announce it as a new change.
- `action: "warned"`: the artwork is turned but the size was NOT changed (`message` says why; `reason: "config-not-synced"` means the file service had not caught up with the configuration, so the proof may come back invalid and need re-running). The proof will show the artwork unrotated, possibly cut off, with a warning. Tell the customer before they review it; offer a corrected file or a different size.
`orientation.message` states what happened in plain words. No `orientation` means the artwork already fits the size's orientation.

ONLY call this on the customer's explicit go-ahead (a create-proof quick-action click or a clear yes) — never unprompted. The file must already be uploaded to the session and the session must be proofable (check get_file_session_proofs / isProofable first).

fileName.description: The file in the session to proof (exact name).

fileSessionId.description: File session ID holding the uploaded file.

name: create_proof
